articles.title: Gateway Distriparks to operate, manage common rail yard terminal at JNPA
articles.desc: Gateway Distriparks Limited has gained a mandate for operating the common rail yard terminal at Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. This terminal will enhance the handling of container trains and improve the efficiency of cargo movement. The contract spans eight years, focusing on train handling, container stacking, and inter-terminal transfers. Gateway aims to work closely with JNPA to improve rail connectivity for trade.

articles.title: IndoSpace launches 1.05M sq ft Narasapura-II industrial and logistics park in Karnataka
articles.desc: IndoSpace has launched Narasapura-II, an industrial and logistics park in Karnataka with a size of approximately 1.05 million square feet. The company announced an investment of Rs 350 crore to enhance its presence in the region. This park aims to support businesses across various sectors including e-commerce and manufacturing. The location in Narasapura is strategically chosen for its connectivity to Bengaluru's markets.

articles.title: Real estate firm Assetz gets Sebi nod to float Rs 1,200-cr IPO

Assetz has developed a substantial land bank and project pipeline to meet housing demand in Bengaluru. With strong backing from investors like AGP Partners, the firm is expanding its presence in key markets.
